## Running a 4-wheeler fleet means running seven businesses at once.

Demand platforms, vehicle financing, drivers (Pilots), charging, workshops, cash collection and payouts. Each has its own app, its own spreadsheet and its own way of failing, and none of them talk to each other.

Current industry challenges

**15-19%**interest on vehicle finance

**~9 hrs**active runtime per vehicle, per day

**~20%**of vehicles in the workshop at any time

**10%**driver (Pilot) bad debt

## One operating layer. Seven connected stages.

The same pieces, organised into one system. Every stage hands its data to the next, and the last one feeds the first.

01 of 07

### Capital & vehicle access

## Two surfaces. One operating picture.

Orbit is where operators run the fleet. The Milo Drive Pilot App is where drivers (Pilots) run their day. Together they make earnings, utilisation, charging and settlements visible to the people who act on them.

Every outcome comes from a mechanism in the system. None of it depends on owning the vehicles.
